ea_managed_calendar.name: EA-Managed Calendar
ea_managed_calendar.note: Optional. A dedicated secondary Google calendar the EA may auto-create attendee-less HOLDS on WITHOUT a Slack button (see Branch B). Events here block availability. Leave calendar_id empty to disable. Isolation is enforced by the calendar-id allowlist in preprocessor/mail_mediation.py (EA_MANAGED_CALENDAR_ID must match); update BOTH if you change the calendar.

outlook.note: Primary work calendar, read via Graph API in preprocessor

google_primary.note: Personal Google Calendar. Read via Google Calendar MCP during Claude runs.

google_secondary.note: Optional second Google Calendar. Leave email empty to skip.
google_secondary.block_note: Set to false for informational calendars (family, shared) whose events don't block your scheduling. Only calendars with blocks_availability=true (or unset, defaults true) count as busy time.

slot_selection.contiguous_note: If I have a meeting at 10:00-10:30, prefer suggesting 10:30 or 9:30 over a random 2pm slot. Cluster meetings together to preserve focus blocks.
slot_selection.max_slot_duration_note: Even if I have a 4-hour free block, only propose 30 or 60 min slots within it. Don't expose the whole block.
slot_selection.vip_override: If user says someone is 'very important' or 'VIP', expand to all available times within working hours extended to 5pm, and remember that person as VIP for future requests.

response_style.default: Propose 2-3 specific times. Short, professional. No 'hope this email finds you well.'
response_style.external_academic: Professional, slightly more formal. Include timezone.
response_style.program_officer: Respectful, accommodating. Offer more options. Always include timezone.
response_style.student: Warm, brief. Fine to suggest 'stop by office hours' as an option.

vip_contacts.note: Populated automatically when user says someone is important in Slack. These contacts get extended hours (to 5pm) and more time options.

_preferences_note: Day/time scheduling preferences (working hours, no-meeting blocks, lunch, no-meeting Friday, morning preference) now live as tokened recurring events on the EA-Managed calendar, NOT here. See skills/scheduling-rules.md. Tokens: wh/nm/p0/p1/p2/wr.
family_calendars_note: Optional, read by the family-sync skill: [{"name": "School calendar", "id": "<google calendar id>"}]. The ids come from `google_calendar_client.py list-calendars`.
